spec.title: VF-010's reproducer before the fix: Pricing#total's regression proof on the own checker, 8 runs alike
spec.description: VF-010 (verification/findings.md): the own checker's branch probes (Engine::probe, lib/src/bmc/mod.rs) are given as long as all the solver calls so far took, at least a second, of wall-clock time, so which side of a branch is left undecided, and with it the path order, depends on the machine's speed. On cvm, 6 of 8 identical runs found the violation in about 4 s and 2 ran out of time. This job runs the new reproducer lib/tests/reproducers/vf-010.sh at the commit before the fix (the cleanup loop's native stream, item N1): it compiles the Pricing fixture of lib/tests/integration.rs and its rounding refactor, and runs 'jvmcontract equivalence --target fixtures.Pricing#total --engine native --timeout 40' 8 times, printing each run's exit and the own checker's numbers to the log. It exits 0 when all 8 find the violation and 1 otherwise. It is expected to reproduce the finding here, exit 1. An exit of 0 means no probe ran out on this runner in these runs, which is information about the reproducer, not a verdict on any fix. It does not close VF-010: the same script at the fixing commit does.
spec.expected: exit 1: the 8 runs differ, some finding the violation in seconds and some running out of time at 40 s (the log lists each run's exit and the own checker's numbers)

resources.notes: one run took 2.7 s and found the violation here in a debug build; a run that runs out stops at 40 s, so at most 8 x 40 s
